name: chad-review
description: Adversarial pre-merge review for Claude Code. /ultra-audit is the merge gate: it reviews the whole PR branch, runs the project's gate and tests, deterministic doc, contract, and dependency scans, Opus finders that report everything, and Opus verifiers that drop a finding only on quoted evidence, never on a confidence score. Fast depth (one finder) for small changes, deep depth (per-block finders, a challenger, one gap sweep) for risky or large ones; both keep and verify every finding. Findings on the change are fixed in the PR at every severity, pre-existing ones go to one follow-up PR, and a GO receipt must record zero open findings. /deps-update takes every dependency to its newest in-range release as its own PR. /chad-review remains the explicit 5-pass fan-out with the same verifier. Not read-only: runs your gate, tests, codegen, and scanner, and backs up untracked files first.
